result.summary: Re-gate of rework iteration 1. Confirmed git diff bb487b5..45d2dfb touches only the handoff JSON -- zero changes under apps/bot/src/, so no source drift since my prior FAIL. Independently re-verified AC2/AC3/AC4 myself: spun up a scratch Postgres via apps/bot/docker-compose.yml, ran drizzle-kit migrate, seeded my own fixture rows (tg_id 2001/lang=en, 2002/lang=NULL+chapter default_lang=en, no row for 2998/2999 -- deliberately different ids from BACKEND-DEV's report to keep this independent), and built my own real grammy.Bot + bot.handleUpdate() harness (dummy token + manual botInfo, bot.api.config.use() intercepting outbound calls only, synthetic message and callback_query Update objects run through the bot's real command/callbackQuery matcher). Captured payloads for /start (en, null-lang-falls-back-to-chapter-default, no-row ru fallback), /lang prompt+keyboard, callback persistence+confirmation, and callback noProfile fallback all matched BACKEND-DEV's reported payloads exactly, both in shape (chat_id/text/reply_markup/callback_query_id) and content. Additionally queried the DB directly after the callback and confirmed users.lang for tg_id 2001 was actually persisted to 'ru' (real UPDATE via setUserLang, not just a reply text match) and that no users row was created for the no-row tg_ids by the /start stub, closing the loop the payload-only check alone would have left open. This satisfies the literal AC2/AC3/AC4 wording: real grammY routing, real Update dispatch, real DB read/write, not a shortcut. Scratch DB torn down (docker compose down -v), scratch script deleted, git status clean after. Re-confirmed (unchanged from step-02b since no source changed): start.ts is genuinely throwaway/read-only (no insert/upsert, no consent/chapter/deep-link handling), domain/*.ts (user.ts, setUserLang.ts) and i18n/resolveLang.ts are framework-free with no grammY import, catalog.ts/en.ts/ru.ts match the four-key shape, lang.ts confirmation text reads from the newly-chosen language not the pre-selection one, index.ts registration matches AC1/AC5. Re-ran npm run lint / npm run build / npm test from repo root: lint 0 errors (2 pre-existing unrelated web warnings), build succeeds, 13/13 tests pass. Diff master...HEAD adds no new npm workspace and does not move any build output, so the Dockerfile-coverage check in my role file does not apply here.
